Reset Insights

This permanently deletes all Insights analytics history, including Website Visits, Visitor Countries, Qualified Card Views, favorites/contact/share engagement, Buyer Funnel data, Quick Winners data, and stored sale/conversion snapshots used by Insights. Inventory, card listings, reviews, giveaways and showcases are not affected. This action cannot be undone.
